calculation:
IF (
    Campaigns[Campaign Start Date] = BLANK (),
    BLANK (),
    DATE ( YEAR ( Campaigns[Campaign Start Date] ), MONTH ( Campaigns[Campaign Start Date] ), 1 )
)

CALCULATE (
            COUNT ( 'Campaigns'[Campaign Id Alt] ),
            Campaigns[Agency] = BLANK() || Campaigns[Agency] = "" || Campaigns[Agency] = "N/A"
        ) + 0

CALCULATE (
            COUNT ( 'Campaigns'[Campaign Id Alt] ),
            Campaigns[Brand] = BLANK() || Campaigns[Brand] = "" || Campaigns[Brand] = "N/A"
        ) + 0

CALCULATE (
            COUNT ( 'Campaigns'[Campaign Id Alt] ),
            Campaigns[Media Type] = BLANK () || Campaigns[Media Type] = "" || Campaigns[Media Type] = "N/A"
        ) + 0

The forecasted marketing spend provided by Brand Team or Agency. The lowest granularity is  brand, vendor, media type, and month level.
calculation:
IF (
    ( ISINSCOPE ( 'Campaigns'[Agency] ) || ISINSCOPE ( 'Campaigns'[Media Type] ) || ISINSCOPE ( 'Material'[Brand] )  )
    && NOT(ISINSCOPE('Campaigns'[Campaign Name]))
    && NOT(ISINSCOPE('Campaigns'[Campaign Type]))
    && NOT(ISINSCOPE('Campaigns'[Media Platform]))
    && NOT(ISINSCOPE('Campaigns'[Search Type]))
    && NOT(ISINSCOPE('Campaigns'[Account Country]))
    && NOT(ISINSCOPE('Campaigns'[Account Country Code]))
    && NOT(ISINSCOPE('Campaigns'[Account Currency Code]))
    && NOT(ISINSCOPE('Campaigns'[Account Name]))
    && NOT(ISINSCOPE('Campaigns'[Brand]))
    && NOT( ISFILTERED('Media Devices') )
    && NOT( ISFILTERED('Keywords') )
    && NOT( ISFILTERED('Affiliates') )
    && NOT( ISFILTERED('Sold-To Customer') )
    && NOT( ISFILTERED('Time'[Week End Date]) )
    && NOT( ISFILTERED('Time'[Week Number]) )
    && NOT( ISFILTERED('Time'[Reporting Date]) ),
    [Forecasted_Budget],
    BLANK()
)

Time Periods can be used with Anchor Date, Anchor Month, Anchor Month Number, and Anchor Week End Date if a user wants to create a specific “as of” time period. Example: If Last Week is used with an Anchor Week End Date of 6/5/2021 then the Last Week would aggregate sales for 5/30/2021 – 6/5/2021. Anchor Date definition may change depending on the fact selected. Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the date the snapshot was taken. Example: Open Orders Snapshot with an Anchor Date selection of 6/7/2021, the data represents what Open Orders were on 6/7/2021. Non-Snapshot Facts: Anchor Date is the last date of transactions included in the time period selected. Example: Invoice Sales with an Anchor Date selection of 6/7/2021, the data represents what shipped on or before 6/7/2021 for the time period selected.
